rows.evidence: java.lang.AssertionError: proxy.md says the client sees the response (status 200) cut short after the headers were sent, but over TinyHttpd a backend that declares Content-Length: 100 and closes after 10 bytes leaves the client with 0 bytes and no status line (access log: [ERROR proxy: the response body from http://127.0.0.1:63516 failed after the response started (INVALID_RESPONSE) null, INFO GET /api/x 200 aborted 0ms in=0 out=10 rid=e136866f4d0f7129])
rows.note: proxy.md and en/proxy.md 'Failures after the response started' say the headers were sent and the client sees a response cut short; for a body that fits the adapter buffer the client receives nothing at all (empty reply), reproduced 3 times; the logging part of the section passed first. A 64 KiB partial body (LP-27) does reach the client as 200 and a cut body.
